ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the diagram, in quadrilateral $ABCD$, $E$ and $F$ are two points on the diagonal $AC$, and $AE=CF$. Quadrilateral $BEDF$ is a parallelogram; if $AB \perp BF$, $AB=8$, $BF=6$, and $AC=16$. Find the length of the line segment $EF$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} In right triangle $Rt\triangle ABF$, we have $AF=\sqrt{AB^{2}+BF^{2}}=\sqrt{8^{2}+6^{2}}=10$,\\
since $AC=16$,\\
then $CF=AC-AF=16-10=6$,\\
since $AE=CF$, thus $AE=6$,\\
therefore $EF=AF-AE=10-6=\boxed{4}$.
